blocks.text: Past Perfect — o'tmishdan ham oldingi o'tmish

Past Perfect (o'tgan tugallangan zamon) — **had + V3** (fe'lning uchinchi shakli), barcha shaxslar uchun bir xil: I / she / they **had gone**; qisqa shakli — **'d**: I**'d gone**, she**'d left**. Bu zamon hikoya qilayotganimizda kerak bo'ladi: biz o'tmishdagi bir **paytda turibmiz** (When I arrived ...) va **undan ham oldin** bo'lgan voqeaga qaraymiz. O'zbek tilida buning aniq muqobili bor — «**-gan edi**», «**-b bo'lgan edi**»: Men kelganimda u **ketib bo'lgan edi** — When I arrived, he **had left**. Shuning uchun bu zamon o'zbeklar uchun qiyin emas, faqat uni o'rinsiz ishlatmaslik kerak.

Vaqt chizig'ini tasavvur qiling: **A** (oldingi voqea) → **B** (biz hikoya qilayotgan o'tmishdagi payt) → hozir. B — Past Simple, A — Past Perfect: When we **got** to the cinema (B), the film **had started** (A). Ikkala harakat ham Past Simple da bo'lsa, ular **ketma-ket** bo'lgan deb tushuniladi: When I **arrived**, Tom **left** — men keldim, **keyin** Tom ketdi. When I arrived, Tom **had left** — Tom men kelishimdan **oldin** ketgan, biz ko'rishmadik.

rows: When I arrived, Tom **had left**. (oldinroq ketgan edi)
When the police came, the thieves **ran** away.
When the police came, the thieves **had run** away.
When we got there, the match **started**.
When we got there, the match **had started**.

items.text: The party **had started** when I arrived.

items.translation: Yarim tunga kelib hamma uyiga **ketib bo'lgan edi**.

blocks.text: Present Perfect — «**hozirgacha**» (→ 7-dars), Past Perfect — «**o'sha paytgacha**». Hozirgi vaziyatni o'tmishga ko'chirsak, Present Perfect Past Perfect ga aylanadi. Shuning uchun **already**, **just**, **never ... before**, **ever**, **yet**, **for**, **since** Past Perfect bilan ham keladi. Ayniqsa «**It was the first time** I**'d** ...» qolipi muhim: ingliz tilida bu yerda Present Perfect emas, Past Perfect ishlatiladi.

rows: This is my first visit. I**'ve never been** here before.
It was my first visit. I**'d never been** there before.
The office is empty. Everyone **has gone** home.
The office was empty. Everyone **had gone** home.

items.text: It was the first time I**'d seen** the sea.
Aziz **had** already **gone** to bed when I called.
items.translation: Qo'ng'iroq qilganimda Aziz allaqachon **yotib qolgan edi**.

items.text: **Had** you ever **been** to Khiva before that trip?
items.translation: O'sha safardan oldin Xivada hech **bo'lgan edingizmi**?

blocks.text: Ketma-ketlik aniq bo'lsa — Past Simple yetarli

Past Perfect «uzoq o'tmish» degani emas. U faqat o'tmishdagi **boshqa payt bilan solishtirganda** kerak. Voqealarni bo'lgan tartibida aytsak, hammasi Past Simple: I **got** up, **had** a shower and **left** for work. **after** va **before** tartibni o'zi ko'rsatadi, shuning uchun Past Perfect ixtiyoriy: After she **(had) finished** her work, she went home. Bitta alohida voqea haqida Past Perfect ishlatilmaydi: I **went** to Samarkand last year («I had been to Samarkand last year» emas).

items.text: I **switched off** the computer, **locked** the door and **went** home.
After the guests **(had) left**, we **washed** the dishes.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «When I arrived, the train already left» → the train **had** already **left**; «It was the first time I've seen ...» → I**'d seen**; «I didn't know him because I never met him before» → I**'d** never **met** him; o'zbekcha «bolaligimda Samarqandga borgan edim» ni avtomatik Past Perfect qilish → I **went** to Samarkand when I was a child (bu yerda o'tmishdagi boshqa payt yo'q); «I had seen him yesterday» → I **saw** him yesterday.

Tekshirish usuli: gapda o'tmishdagi **ikkinchi payt** bormi (when I arrived, by the time ..., before ..., «o'sha paytga kelib»)? Bo'lsa va harakat undan **oldin** bo'lgan bo'lsa — had + V3. Bunday payt bo'lmasa — Past Simple.
**'d** ikki xil so'zning qisqa shakli: **had** va **would**. Undan keyin V3 kelsa — had (I**'d gone** = I had gone), fe'lning oddiy shakli kelsa — would (I**'d go** = I would go, → 36-dars).

rows: When we arrived, the film **had started**.
I **saw** snow in Oxford last year.

examples.title: **had** + V3: it **had** already **happened**
examples.description: Biz o'tmishdagi bir paytdan turib, undan ham oldin bo'lgan harakatga qaraymiz: had + V3. O'zbekchada «-gan edi», «-b bo'lgan edi».

sentences.text: When we got to the station, the train **had** already **left**.
sentences.translation: Biz vokzalga yetib borganimizda, poyezd allaqachon **jo'nab ketgan edi**.

sentences.text: Sarah was very tired because she **had worked** a twelve-hour shift.
sentences.translation: Sara juda charchagan edi, chunki u o'n ikki soatlik smenada **ishlagan edi**.

sentences.text: The streets were wet — it **had rained** during the night.
sentences.translation: Ko'chalar ho'l edi — kechasi yomg'ir **yoqqan edi**.

sentences.text: I recognised the man at once because I **had seen** his photo in the news.
sentences.translation: O'sha odamni darhol tanidim, chunki uning suratini yangiliklarda **ko'rgan edim**.

sentences.text: By nine o'clock most of the guests **had gone** home.
sentences.translation: Soat to'qqizga kelib mehmonlarning ko'pchiligi uyiga **ketib bo'lgan edi**.

sentences.text: Aziz proudly showed me the flat he **had bought** in the new district.
sentences.translation: Aziz yangi mavzeda **sotib olgan** kvartirasini menga faxr bilan ko'rsatdi.

sentences.text: Somebody **had broken** the window, so the room was freezing.
sentences.translation: Kimdir derazani **sindirgan edi**, shuning uchun xona muzdek edi.

sentences.text: Madina felt much more confident because she **had practised** her speech many times.
sentences.translation: Madina o'zini ancha ishonchli his qildi, chunki nutqini ko'p marta **mashq qilgan edi**.

sentences.text: Dinner was ready: Jasur **had cooked** plov for the whole family.
sentences.translation: Kechki ovqat tayyor edi: Jasur butun oila uchun palov **damlagan edi**.

sentences.text: Emma couldn't pay for her coffee — she**'d left** her purse in the office.
sentences.translation: Emma qahvasi uchun to'lay olmadi — hamyonini ofisda **qoldirgan edi**.

examples.title: Negatives and questions: **hadn't** ... / **Had** you ...?
examples.description: Inkor — hadn't + V3 («-magan edi»), so'roq — Had + ega + V3 ...? («-gan edingizmi?»). Ko'pincha already, yet, ever, before bilan.

sentences.text: I **hadn't finished** my report when the boss asked for it.
sentences.translation: Boshliq hisobotni so'raganida, men uni hali **tugatmagan edim**.

sentences.text: Tom was surprised that nobody **had told** him about the meeting.
sentences.translation: Majlis haqida unga hech kim **aytmaganidan** Tom hayron bo'ldi.

sentences.text: **Had** you **met** Bekzod before the wedding? — No, it was the first time.
sentences.translation: To'ydan oldin Bekzod bilan **tanishgan edingizmi**? — Yo'q, birinchi marta ko'rishimiz edi.

sentences.text: The film was confusing because we **hadn't seen** the first part.
sentences.translation: Film tushunarsiz edi, chunki biz birinchi qismini **ko'rmagan edik**.

sentences.text: Kate asked why the café **had closed** so early that day.
sentences.translation: Keyt o'sha kuni kafe nega bunchalik erta **yopilganini** so'radi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **hadn't eaten** since breakfast, so she was starving by six.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza nonushtadan beri hech narsa **yemagan edi**, shuning uchun soat oltiga kelib qorni juda ochqagan edi.

sentences.text: **Had** the plane **landed** when you called your mum?
sentences.translation: Onangga qo'ng'iroq qilganingda samolyot **qo'nib bo'lganmidi**?

sentences.text: Oliver failed the exam because he **hadn't revised** properly.
sentences.translation: Oliver imtihondan o'ta olmadi, chunki yaxshilab **takrorlamagan edi**.

sentences.text: Luckily, the rain **hadn't started** yet when we set off for Khiva.
sentences.translation: Baxtimizga, Xivaga yo'lga chiqqanimizda yomg'ir hali **boshlanmagan edi**.

sentences.text: How long **had** they **known** each other before they got married?
sentences.translation: Turmush qurishgunga qadar ular necha yil **tanish bo'lgan edi**?

examples.title: **he left** or **he had left**? Two different stories
examples.description: Past Simple + Past Simple — harakatlar ketma-ket (biri ikkinchisidan keyin). Past Simple + Past Perfect — had bilan kelgan harakat oldinroq bo'lgan. Ma'no butunlay o'zgaradi.

sentences.text: As I walked into the room, Tom got up and **left** — clearly he didn't want to see me.
sentences.translation: Men xonaga kirganimda Tom o'rnidan turib **chiqib ketdi** — meni ko'rishni xohlamagani aniq edi.

sentences.text: When I walked into the room, Tom **had** already **left**, so we didn't meet.
sentences.translation: Men xonaga kirganimda Tom allaqachon **chiqib ketgan edi**, shuning uchun ko'rishmadik.

sentences.text: The police **arrived**, and the thieves **ran** away.
sentences.translation: Politsiya **yetib keldi** va o'g'rilar **qochib qolishdi**.

sentences.text: By the time the police **arrived**, the thieves **had run** away.
sentences.translation: Politsiya **yetib kelganida** o'g'rilar allaqachon **qochib ketgan edi**.

sentences.text: The match **started** as soon as we **sat** down.
sentences.translation: Biz **o'tirishimiz** bilan o'yin **boshlandi**.

sentences.text: The match **had started** before we found our seats, so we missed the first goal.
sentences.translation: Biz joyimizni topgunimizcha o'yin **boshlangan edi**, shuning uchun birinchi golni ko'rmay qoldik.

sentences.text: Was Madina at home when you phoned? — Yes, but she **went** out soon afterwards.
sentences.translation: Qo'ng'iroq qilganingda Madina uydamidi? — Ha, lekin ko'p o'tmay **chiqib ketdi**.

sentences.text: Was Madina at home? — No, she **had** already **gone** to work.
sentences.translation: Madina uydamidi? — Yo'q, u allaqachon ishga **ketib bo'lgan edi**.

sentences.text: As soon as I **got** home, my husband **made** tea.
sentences.translation: Uyga **kelishim** bilan erim choy **damladi**.

sentences.text: When I **got** home, my husband **had** already **made** tea and **laid** the table.
sentences.translation: Uyga **kelganimda** erim allaqachon choy **damlab**, dasturxon **yozib qo'ygan edi**.

examples.title: First time: **I'd never** ... **before**
examples.description: Present Perfect (I've never ... before) o'tmishga ko'chganda Past Perfect bo'ladi: It was the first time I'd ever ... — «...birinchi marta edi», «ilgari hech ...magan edim».

sentences.text: It was Kate's first visit to Uzbekistan — she **had never been** to Central Asia before.
sentences.translation: Bu Keytning O'zbekistonga birinchi tashrifi edi — u ilgari hech Markaziy Osiyoda **bo'lmagan edi**.

sentences.text: I was nervous on the plane because I **had never flown** before.
sentences.translation: Samolyotda hayajonlandim, chunki ilgari hech **uchmagan edim**.

sentences.text: It was the first time Jasur **had driven** in the snow, so he went very slowly.
sentences.translation: Jasur qorda birinchi marta **mashina haydashi** edi, shuning uchun juda sekin yurdi.

sentences.text: The food tasted strange to Oliver — he **hadn't tried** horse meat before.
sentences.translation: Ovqat Oliverga g'alati tuyuldi — u ilgari ot go'shtini **tatib ko'rmagan edi**.

sentences.text: Nilufar didn't know anybody at the conference; she **had** never **met** her colleagues in person.
sentences.translation: Nilufar konferensiyada hech kimni tanimasdi: u hamkasblarini hech qachon yuzma-yuz **ko'rmagan edi**.

sentences.text: That was the best concert we **had** ever **been** to.
sentences.translation: Bu biz **borgan** eng zo'r konsert edi.

sentences.text: **Had** you ever **seen** snow before you came to Manchester?
sentences.translation: Manchesterga kelishingizdan oldin hech qor **ko'rgan edingizmi**?

sentences.text: The children were amazed by the sea — they **had** only **seen** it on TV.
sentences.translation: Bolalar dengizni ko'rib hayratda qolishdi — ular uni faqat televizorda **ko'rgan edi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod looked terrified: he **had** never **given** a speech in English before.
sentences.translation: Bekzod juda qo'rqib ketgan ko'rinardi: u ilgari hech qachon ingliz tilida nutq **so'zlamagan edi**.

sentences.text: Grandma was delighted by her first video call; she **had** never **seen** her grandchildren on a screen before.
sentences.translation: Buvim birinchi video qo'ng'iroqdan juda xursand bo'ldi: u ilgari nevaralarini hech ekranda **ko'rmagan edi**.

examples.title: Explaining the past: because she **had lost** ...
examples.description: O'tmishdagi holatni tushuntirish: nega shunday bo'lgan edi? Sabab undan oldinroq bo'lgan — because / as / since + Past Perfect.

sentences.text: Tom was in a terrible mood because he **had lost** his phone on the bus.
sentences.translation: Tomning kayfiyati juda yomon edi, chunki telefonini avtobusda **yo'qotib qo'ygan edi**.

sentences.text: The roads were blocked because a lorry **had overturned** near Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Yo'llar to'silgan edi, chunki Samarqand yaqinida yuk mashinasi **ag'darilib ketgan edi**.

sentences.text: Why was Madina crying? — Her grandfather **had died** the week before.
sentences.translation: Madina nega yig'layotgan edi? — Bir hafta oldin bobosi **vafot etgan edi**.

sentences.text: We couldn't get into the flat, as somebody **had changed** the locks.
sentences.translation: Kvartiraga kira olmadik, chunki kimdir qulflarni **almashtirib qo'ygan edi**.

sentences.text: The company went bankrupt because its owners **had borrowed** too much money.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya bankrot bo'ldi, chunki egalari juda ko'p qarz **olgan edi**.

sentences.text: My plants were dying — I **hadn't watered** them for two weeks.
sentences.translation: Gullarim so'lib qolayotgan edi — ularni ikki hafta **sug'ormagan edim**.

sentences.text: Emma felt guilty, since she **had forgotten** her best friend's birthday.
sentences.translation: Emma o'zini aybdor his qildi, chunki eng yaqin dugonasining tug'ilgan kunini **unutib qo'ygan edi**.

sentences.text: Jasur got the job easily because he **had studied** in Edinburgh for two years.
sentences.translation: Jasur ishga oson kirdi, chunki u Edinburgda ikki yil **o'qigan edi**.

sentences.text: Nobody answered the door: the family **had gone** to the mountains for the weekend.
sentences.translation: Eshikni hech kim ochmadi: oila dam olish kunlari uchun toqqa **ketgan edi**.

sentences.text: Was the hotel nice? — No, it was awful; they **hadn't cleaned** the room properly.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona yaxshimidi? — Yo'q, dahshat edi: xonani yaxshilab **tozalashmagan edi**.

examples.title: **by the time**, **already**, **just**, **until**
examples.description: Past Perfect ko'pincha by the time («...guncha»), already, just, until, after, before bilan keladi. after / before tartibni o'zi ko'rsatgani uchun u yerda Past Perfect ixtiyoriy.

sentences.text: A nurse **had** already **helped** the injured cyclist **by the time** the ambulance arrived.
sentences.translation: Tez yordam **yetib kelguncha** bir hamshira jarohatlangan velosipedchiga allaqachon **yordam ko'rsatgan edi**.

sentences.text: The bus **had just left** when I got to the stop.
sentences.translation: Bekatga yetib kelganimda avtobus **hozirgina ketgan edi**.

sentences.text: **By the time** I finished university, my parents **had moved** to Fergana.
sentences.translation: Men universitetni **bitirgunimcha** ota-onam Farg'onaga **ko'chib ketgan edi**.

sentences.text: **After** they **had signed** the contract, everyone went out for dinner.
sentences.translation: Shartnomani **imzolab bo'lgach**, hamma kechki ovqatga chiqdi.

sentences.text: I didn't feel the pain in my knee **until** the match **had finished**.
sentences.translation: O'yin **tugaguncha** tizzamdagi og'riqni sezmadim.

sentences.text: Kate **had** already **booked** the tickets, so we didn't need to queue.
sentences.translation: Keyt chiptalarni allaqachon **bron qilib qo'ygan edi**, shuning uchun navbatda turishimiz shart bo'lmadi.

sentences.text: We **had** only just **sat** down to dinner when the lights went out.
sentences.translation: Kechki ovqatga endigina **o'tirgan edik**, chiroqlar o'chib qoldi.

sentences.text: **Before** he became a teacher, Aziz **had worked** as a translator for five years.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi bo'lishidan **oldin** Aziz besh yil tarjimon bo'lib **ishlagan edi**.

sentences.text: Oliver didn't leave the office **until** he **had answered** every email.
sentences.translation: Oliver barcha xatlarga **javob bermaguncha** ofisdan chiqmadi.

sentences.text: **By the end of** the year, the start-up **had grown** from three people to forty.
sentences.translation: Yil **oxiriga kelib** startap uch kishidan qirq kishiga **o'sgan edi**.

examples.title: Dialogue: why were you so late?
examples.description: Do'stlar kechikish sababini muhokama qiladi: kechagi voqealar Past Simple da, ulardan oldin bo'lgan narsalar — Past Perfect da.

sentences.text: — Where were you last night? We **had** already **eaten** when you finally arrived!
sentences.translation: — Kecha qayerda eding? Sen nihoyat kelganingda biz allaqachon **ovqatlanib bo'lgan edik**!

sentences.text: — I'm so sorry. Everything **had gone** wrong by six o'clock.
sentences.translation: — Juda uzr. Soat oltiga kelib hammasi **chappasiga ketgan edi**.

sentences.text: — Really? What **had happened**? You sounded fine at lunch.
sentences.translation: — Rostdanmi? Nima **bo'lgan edi**? Tushlikda kayfiyating yaxshi edi-ku.

sentences.text: — First, I discovered that someone **had taken** my umbrella from the office.
sentences.translation: — Avval kimdir ofisdan soyabonimni **olib ketganini** bildim.

sentences.text: — Oh no! And the forecast **had promised** heavy rain.
sentences.translation: — Voy! Ob-havo ma'lumoti esa kuchli yomg'ir **va'da qilgan edi**.

sentences.text: — Exactly. Then I got to the bus stop, and the last bus **had** just **gone**.
sentences.translation: — Xuddi shunday. Keyin bekatga yetib keldim, oxirgi avtobus esa hozirgina **ketib qolgan edi**.

sentences.text: — Couldn't you take a taxi? — I tried, but my phone battery **had died**.
sentences.translation: — Taksiga o'tirsang bo'lmasmidi? — Urindim, lekin telefonimning quvvati **tugab qolgan edi**.

sentences.text: — What a nightmare! **Had** you ever **had** a day like that before?
sentences.translation: — Qanday dahshat! Ilgari hech shunday kunni **boshdan kechirgan edingmi**?

sentences.text: — Never! In the end a kind neighbour who **had seen** me in the rain gave me a lift.
sentences.translation: — Hech qachon! Oxiri meni yomg'irda **ko'rib qolgan** mehribon qo'shnim mashinasida olib keldi.

sentences.text: — Well, you're here now, and luckily we **hadn't eaten** all the cake!
sentences.translation: — Mayli, mana kelding, baxtingga tortning hammasini **yeb qo'ymagan edik**!

examples.title: Mixed: had done, did or have done?
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: Past Perfect (oldingi o'tmish), Past Simple (ketma-ket voqealar) va Present Perfect (hozirgacha) — hikoya va yangiliklarda.

sentences.text: I'm not hungry, thanks — I**'ve** just **had** lunch.
sentences.translation: Rahmat, qornim to'q — hozirgina **tushlik qildim**.

sentences.text: I wasn't hungry at the party, because I **had** just **had** lunch.
sentences.translation: Bazmda qornim och emasdi, chunki hozirgina **tushlik qilgan edim**.

sentences.text: When Dilnoza opened the letter, she **realised** that she **had won** a scholarship.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza xatni ochganida, grant **yutganini** **tushundi**.

sentences.text: The detective soon discovered that the suspect **had lied** about where he was.
sentences.translation: Detektiv tez orada gumonlanuvchi qayerda bo'lgani haqida **yolg'on gapirganini** aniqladi.

sentences.text: We **got** to the cinema, **bought** popcorn and **found** our seats just in time.
sentences.translation: Kinoteatrga **yetib keldik**, popkorn **oldik** va o'z joylarimizni o'z vaqtida **topdik**.

sentences.text: Sarah said she **had** never **tasted** melons as sweet as the ones in Khorezm.
sentences.translation: Sara Xorazmdagidek shirin qovunni hech qachon **tatib ko'rmaganini** aytdi.

sentences.text: Oliver **was** sure he **had locked** the door, but it was wide open when he came back.
sentences.translation: Oliver eshikni **qulflaganiga** amin **edi**, lekin qaytib kelganida u lang ochiq edi.

sentences.text: Two weeks after the floods, the water **had** finally **gone**, and people **started** repairing their homes.
sentences.translation: Toshqindan ikki hafta o'tib suv nihoyat **qaytgan edi** va odamlar uylarini **ta'mirlay boshladi**.

sentences.text: **Had** you **heard** about the strike before you got to the airport?
sentences.translation: Aeroportga yetib borishingdan oldin ish tashlash haqida **eshitgan edingmi**?

sentences.text: It wasn't the first time the river **had flooded** the village, so people **were** ready.
sentences.translation: Daryo qishloqni birinchi marta **suv bosishi** emas edi, shuning uchun odamlar tayyor **turishgan**.
